description: Makes a free printable sheet of 8 math word problems for a US grade (1 to 6), optionally on one topic (see list_worksheet_topics). Each problem comes with its answer, the worked line, and a focus question a grown-up can ask instead of giving the answer. Returns a printable link. Use the same seed to get the same sheet again.

seed.description: Leave out for a new sheet.

topic.description: A topic slug for that grade, e.g. "fraction" or "multiplication-and-division". Leave out for a mix of the grade's skills.

name: make_worksheet
title: Math word problem worksheet
